title: Kubernetes Engineer
description: Master container orchestration at scale: cluster administration, service mesh, networking, security policies, storage, and GitOps workflows.

goal.objective: Operate, secure, and scale production-grade Kubernetes clusters hosting mission-critical distributed workloads.

learn.summary: Master Kubernetes control plane internals, etcd backup/restore, CNI networking (Calico/Cilium), CSI persistent storage, Helm charts, RBAC security, and cluster upgrades.

capstone_projects.title: Production Multi-Tenant Kubernetes Platform with Cilium eBPF & GitOps
capstone_projects.description: Architect an enterprise multi-tenant Kubernetes platform enforcing strict eBPF network policies, OPA admission control, and zero-trust mutual TLS service meshing.

capstone_projects.title: Custom Kubernetes Operator for Automated Database Lifecycle & Backups
capstone_projects.description: Develop a production Go operator managing custom database cluster resources, automated point-in-time snapshotting, and health-check reconciliation loops.

interview_focus: Kubernetes Control Plane Architecture (API Server, etcd quorum, Kube-Scheduler, Kube-Controller-Manager)
Kubelet Pod Lifecycle, Container Runtime Interface (CRI) & OOMKiller Mechanics
Kubernetes Networking Model (CNI Plugins, ClusterIP, NodePort, Ingress Controllers, eBPF)
Admission Controllers (Mutating vs Validating Webhooks) & Policy Enforcement (OPA/Kyverno)
Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) & Operator Reconcile Loop Idempotency

tree.name: Foundational Skills for Kubernetes Engineers
tree.description: Establish an unshakeable cloud-native systems foundation: master Linux kernel isolation primitives (cgroups v2, namespaces), container networking mechanics (veth pairs, iptables, IPVS), OCI runtimes, and Kubernetes control plane architecture.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners FULL COURSE (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Linux System Internals & Shell Scripting
children.description: Master Linux kernel internals for containerization: cgroups v2 for CPU and memory resource constraints (CFS bandwidth control, OOM killer triggers), namespaces (PID, network, mount, IPC, UTS, user), systemd service management, bash automation scripts, and kernel networking tuning via `sysctl` (`net.ipv4.ip_forward`, `bridge-nf-call-iptables`, `net.core.somaxconn`).

children.name: Networking Essentials Deep Dive
children.description: Master container networking from first principles: virtual ethernet (veth) pairs, Linux network bridges (`cbr0`), packet routing with iptables (PREROUTING, POSTROUTING, NAT tables) vs high-performance IPVS, overlay networks (VXLAN encapsulation, Geneve), CIDR IP subnet planning for Pods and Services, and DNS resolution workflows via CoreDNS.

resources.title: Kubernetes Security Best Practices (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Containerization with Docker & OCI Standards
children.description: Master Open Container Initiative (OCI) standards: Container Runtime Interface (CRI) implementations (containerd, CRI-O), low-level runtimes (`runc`, `crun`), authoring hardened multi-stage Dockerfiles, minimizing layer count and image attack surfaces, non-root user security enforcement, and signing container images with Cosign.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners [FULL COURSE in 4 Hours] (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Git and Version Control
children.description: Apply disciplined Git workflows for infrastructure-as-code and GitOps: multi-environment repository structuring (base and overlays), commit signing with GPG, semantic versioning, and managing declarative manifest repositories with automated PR validation.

resources.title: Git Branching - Basic Branching and Merging
Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners FULL COURSE (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Kubernetes Core Concepts & Architecture
children.description: Deep dive into Kubernetes control plane and node architecture: `kube-apiserver` (authentication, authorization, mutating/validating admission webhooks), `etcd` distributed key-value store (Raft consensus, quorum, snapshotting, compaction), `kube-scheduler` (filtering, scoring, node affinity, taints/tolerations), `kube-controller-manager` reconciliation loops, and worker node components (`kubelet` sync loop, `kube-proxy`, CRI runtime).

children.name: Local Kubernetes Development & kubectl Mastery
children.description: Master local cluster development and advanced `kubectl` operations: spinning up lightweight local multi-node clusters with KinD (Kubernetes in Docker) and k3d, `kubectl` output parsing (`-o jsonpath`, custom-columns), context management with `kubectx`/`kubens`, imperative debugging commands, and declarative dry-run diffing (`kubectl apply --dry-run=server --diff`).

resources.title: Kubernetes Security Best Practices (TechWorld with Nana)

tree.name: Kubernetes Application Deployment and Management
tree.description: Deploy and orchestrate enterprise workloads: manage stateful and stateless applications, service discovery, configuration decoupling, persistent storage, packaging with Helm, and autoscaling.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners [FULL COURSE in 4 Hours] (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Workload Management: Pods, Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Jobs
children.description: Master workload primitives and lifecycle management: Pod lifecycle phases and conditions, pre-stop hooks and graceful shutdown (`terminationGracePeriodSeconds`), Deployments (rolling updates, rollback strategies, `maxSurge` / `maxUnavailable`), StatefulSets (stable network identities, headless Services, ordered deployment, `volumeClaimTemplates`), DaemonSets for node-level agents, and Jobs/CronJobs for batch processing.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners FULL COURSE (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Service Discovery and Load Balancing
children.description: Master Kubernetes service networking and traffic routing: Service types (ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, ExternalName), headless services for stateful peering, CoreDNS customization, Ingress Controllers (NGINX Ingress, Traefik), SSL/TLS termination with Cert-Manager, and next-generation Kubernetes Gateway API.

children.name: Configuration, Secrets, and Resource Management
children.description: Manage application configuration and sensitive credentials: immutable ConfigMaps, Secret types (Opaque, TLS, dockerconfigjson), integrating external secret management systems (External Secrets Operator syncing from AWS Secrets Manager / HashiCorp Vault), and enforcing resource governance using ResourceQuotas and LimitRanges.

resources.title: Kubernetes Security Best Practices (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Persistent Storage in Kubernetes
children.description: Orchestrate persistent state in Kubernetes: PersistentVolumes (PV), PersistentVolumeClaims (PVC), StorageClasses for dynamic volume provisioning, access modes (ReadWriteOnce, ReadWriteMany, ReadOnlyMany), volume reclaim policies (Retain, Delete), Container Storage Interface (CSI) drivers, and volume expansion and snapshotting.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners [FULL COURSE in 4 Hours] (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Application Packaging with Helm
children.description: Master application packaging with Helm 3: authoring production Helm charts, Go template functions and control structures, validating values with JSON schema (`values.schema.json`), managing chart dependencies, implementing Helm lifecycle hooks (pre-install, post-upgrade), and publishing charts to OCI registries.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners FULL COURSE (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Scaling and Autoscaling Applications
children.description: Implement multi-dimensional autoscaling: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA v2) scaling on CPU, memory, and custom Prometheus metrics via KEDA (Kubernetes Event-driven Autoscaling), Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA) in recommendation mode, Karpenter for high-speed just-in-time cloud node provisioning, and configuring Pod Disruption Budgets (PDB) to safeguard high availability during node drains.

children.name: Debugging and Troubleshooting Applications
children.description: Diagnose and resolve application failures systematically: analyzing Pod termination reasons (OOMKilled, CrashLoopBackOff, Error), inspecting logs (`kubectl logs -f --previous`), cluster event auditing, troubleshooting container crashes using ephemeral debug containers (`kubectl debug`), and configuring robust Liveness, Readiness, and Startup Probes to prevent traffic routing to unready pods.

resources.title: Configure Liveness, Readiness and Startup Probes
Kubernetes Security Best Practices (TechWorld with Nana)

tree.name: Advanced Operations, Security, and Ecosystem
tree.description: Operate enterprise Kubernetes clusters at scale: zero-trust cluster security, GitOps continuous delivery, eBPF networking, service meshes, custom controllers, disaster recovery, and chaos engineering.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners [FULL COURSE in 4 Hours] (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Kubernetes Security Best Practices
children.description: Harden Kubernetes clusters against attacks: enforcing Pod Security Standards (Privileged, Baseline, Restricted) via Pod Security Admission, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC with least-privilege ServiceAccounts), NetworkPolicies (default-deny ingress and egress), image scanning with Trivy, runtime anomaly detection with Falco (eBPF syscall auditing), and declarative policy enforcement using Kyverno or OPA Gatekeeper.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners FULL COURSE (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Observability: Monitoring, Logging, Tracing
children.description: Deploy and maintain enterprise observability: deploying Prometheus Operator (kube-prometheus-stack), configuring custom ServiceMonitors and PodMonitors, authoring PromQL alerting rules, visualizing cluster performance in Grafana, aggregating logs with Fluent Bit / Vector to Grafana Loki, and distributed tracing using OpenTelemetry and Tempo.

children.name: CI/CD & GitOps with Kubernetes
children.description: Implement enterprise GitOps pipelines: automated declarative continuous delivery with Argo CD or Flux CD, managing multi-tenant repositories, automated drift detection and self-healing, and advanced progressive delivery using Argo Rollouts (Canary and Blue/Green deployments with automated metrics analysis).

resources.title: Kubernetes Security Best Practices (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Kubernetes Networking Deep Dive & Service Mesh
children.description: Master advanced cloud-native networking: eBPF-powered CNI with Cilium (replacing kube-proxy with eBPF for high-throughput routing, XDP acceleration, and Layer 7 network security), and deploying Service Meshes (Istio or Linkerd) for transparent mutual TLS (mTLS), traffic splitting, and distributed fault injection.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners [FULL COURSE in 4 Hours] (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Cloud Provider Kubernetes Services (EKS, AKS, GKE)
children.description: Architect and operate managed cloud Kubernetes: AWS EKS, Google Cloud GKE, and Azure AKS. Implementing cloud IAM identity federation (AWS IRSA / EKS Pod Identities, GCP Workload Identity), managed node group lifecycles, Spot instance cost optimization with graceful termination handling, and integrating cloud load balancer controllers (AWS Load Balancer Controller).

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners FULL COURSE (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Kubernetes Operators & Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs)
children.description: Extend the Kubernetes API: authoring Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) with OpenAPI v3 schema validation, writing custom Kubernetes Operators in Go using Kubebuilder and Operator SDK, implementing the controller reconciliation loop, watching resources with Informers and Caches, and managing stateful application lifecycles automatically.

resources.title: Extend the Kubernetes API with CustomResources

children.name: Cluster Management: Upgrades, Backup, & Disaster Recovery
children.description: Manage cluster lifecycle and disaster recovery: zero-downtime cluster version upgrades (`kubeadm upgrade`, node cordoning and draining), performing `etcd` snapshot backups and disaster recovery restorations, node OS patching, and implementing whole-cluster multi-region backups with Velero.

resources.title: Velero for Kubernetes Backup and Restore
Kubernetes Security Best Practices (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Performance Tuning & Cost Optimization
children.description: Optimize cluster performance and cloud infrastructure costs: tuning node kernel parameters, setting optimal resource requests to prevent CPU throttling and eliminate OOMKills, implementing right-sizing recommendations with Goldilocks, and monitoring cloud infrastructure spend with Kubecost.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners [FULL COURSE in 4 Hours] (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Advanced Troubleshooting & Chaos Engineering
children.description: Troubleshoot complex cluster outages and inject chaos: debugging node `NotReady` conditions, CNI IP exhaustion, etcd split-brain quorum loss, inspecting network traffic inside pod namespaces with `nsenter` and `tcpdump`, and conducting proactive Chaos Engineering experiments with Chaos Mesh or LitmusChaos.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners FULL COURSE (TechWorld with Nana)

tree.name: Portfolio and Career Readiness
tree.description: Demonstrate production Kubernetes engineering mastery: build an enterprise-grade platform capstone, author real-world post-mortems, and excel in CKA/CKS scenario-based technical interviews.

children.name: Case Study Writing
children.description: Author professional engineering case studies: documenting a zero-downtime multi-cluster migration, a 40% cloud cost reduction initiative using Karpenter and Spot instances, or a production incident post-mortem detailing detection, mitigation, root cause, and preventative action items.

resources.title: How to Write a Technical Case Study
Kubernetes Security Best Practices (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Project: Kubernetes Engineer Portfolio Capstone
children.description: Capstone Project: Architect and deploy an enterprise multi-tenant Kubernetes platform: automated GitOps with Argo CD, Cilium eBPF CNI, Kyverno security policies, Cert-Manager with automated Let's Encrypt TLS, Prometheus/Grafana monitoring, Argo Rollouts canary progressive delivery, and Velero automated backup to cloud object storage.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners [FULL COURSE in 4 Hours] (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Mock Interviews and Technical Assessments
children.description: Excel in Kubernetes engineering interviews: scenario-based troubleshooting under pressure (recovering crashed control planes, debugging broken CNI routing), system design of large-scale multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters, deep explanations of Kubernetes internals (etcd, scheduler, kubelet), and CKA/CKS exam preparation.
